text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh. A tackle shop in a place like this. I 
never noticed it until now...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa! This rod... is made of the 
brand-new material that was just 
announced...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Read the tide, cast the lure... Yeah, 
it'll have plenty of flex."

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, taking an interest in that rod! You 
must be quite the seasoned angler!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Please, take a look inside the store as 
well! We carry items from rare brands too! 
Come on in, right this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Cheval Grand ended up being late 
for training.
